ledger.statement: a single order request results in at most one gateway charge call
ledger.why: the payment provider bills per API call and rate-limits us

ledger.statement: the same idempotency key creates exactly one order
ledger.why: clients may retry on network failure; we must not double-charge

ledger.statement: every order write passes through validate_order()
ledger.why: validate_order() is the single enforcement point for business rules

ledger.statement: catalog reads are served from cache; DB hit rate < 20% once warm
ledger.why: the catalog changes infrequently; hitting the DB on every read adds latency
